description: Ready briefing for one team (any sport but cricket; for tennis a player): form, streaks (overall, home, away; streak_season_best: the longest of the season), home and away record, table place and gaps, last and next match, congestion (games_last_7d, games_last_14d in every competition, rest_days from the last match to the next), injuries (soccer); what its last match ended (runs; soccer: first_since_* waits); soccer player milestones for the club (debut, first goal, 50/100/150 league appearances, 25/50/75 league goals, milestone_next before the next match; only when our statistics hold the whole season); each also as a sentence (lang de, es, it, fr), and summary: the most important ones as one paragraph. Facts only. Insights feature.

format.description: md for a short Markdown text instead of JSON

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

sport.description: sport (default soccer); for tennis the id is a player id

team_id.description: team code (or number) from find_teams or a match (tennis: player id)

name: get_team_briefing
